sql:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        date_trunc('month', started_at)::date AS trip_month,
        member_casual,
        COUNT(ride_id) AS trip_count
    FROM ds_ga_trips
    WHERE member_casual IN ('member', 'casual')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
rolling AS (
    SELECT 
        trip_month,
        member_casual,
        trip_count,
        AVG(trip_count) OVER (
            PARTITION BY member_casual 
            ORDER BY trip_month 
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rolling_3m_avg
    FROM monthly
)
SELECT 
    trip_month,
    member_casual,
    trip_count,
    ROUND(rolling_3m_avg, 1) AS rolling_3m_avg
FROM rolling
ORDER BY member_casual, trip_month;

answer: Total Q1 Trip Count 374,952 | Latest Q1 Trip Count 19,034 | Total Q4 Trip Count 1,238,744 | Latest Q4 Trip Count 35,426 | Total Q1 Avg Duration Min 119.5 | Latest Q1 Avg Duration Min 85.72 | Total Q4 Avg Duration Min 124.07 | Latest Q4 Avg Duration Min 94.57 | Total Trip Growth 863,792 | Latest Trip Growth 16,392 | Total Trip Growth Pct 708.13 | Latest Trip Growth Pct 86.12 | Total Duration Change Min 4.57 | Latest Duration Change Min 8.85
sql:
WITH quarterly AS (
    SELECT 
        rideable_type,
        EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM started_at)::int AS quarter,
        COUNT(*) AS trip_count,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at))/60.0) AS avg_duration_minutes
    FROM ds_ga_trips
    WHERE started_at >= '2021-01-01' AND started_at < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY rideable_type, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM started_at)
)
SELECT 
    q1.rideable_type,
    q1.trip_count AS q1_trip_count,
    q4.trip_count AS q4_trip_count,
    q1.avg_duration_minutes AS q1_avg_duration_min,
    q4.avg_duration_minutes AS q4_avg_duration_min,
    (q4.trip_count - q1.trip_count) AS trip_growth,
    ROUND((q4.trip_count - q1.trip_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(q1.trip_count,0), 2) AS trip_growth_pct,
    ROUND(q4.avg_duration_minutes - q1.avg_duration_minutes, 2) AS duration_change_min
FROM quarterly q1
JOIN quarterly q4 ON q1.rideable_type = q4.rideable_type AND q4.quarter = 4
WHERE q1.quarter = 1
ORDER BY trip_growth_pct DESC NULLS LAST;
